READ FIRST: 229:1088 is an INSTANCE, 119x32, layoutMode HORIZONTAL, layoutSizingHorizontal FIXED, variants Kind=primary;Size=md;State=rest, and its label I229:1088;9:19 is 127px wide and HUG — so the string needs 127 in a 119 box and overflows 4px on each side, which is exactly what the 18:19 detector logged as 'ESCAPES … by 4 past 229:1088'. WHY NOT RESIZE THE LABEL: it already needs its 127px; shrinking it clips the word. WHY NOT A FIXED WIDTH: the same 119x32 button carries the same 127px label on six more boards (DEAD-CONTROLS-V2.txt:686-711), so a hand-set width repairs one and leaves the rest. HUG plus the family's own 12px horizontal padding — measured from the sibling button on this board, whose label starts 12px inside its 16px-inset column — lets each button size to its own text, which is the fix that does not need repeating. SAFE BY CONSTRUCTION: hug-width reports NOAUTOLAYOUT if a node is not an auto-layout frame and MISSING if an id is wrong, so the six ids taken from a file the F10 author flagged as partly stale cannot damage anything — they either apply or report. Growth is bounded: 116 + 151 = 267 inside a 280-wide panel.
